text:
The blood smear findings are concerning for a myelodysplastic process; the presence of immature cells with prominent nucleoli and "pink, elongated, needle-shaped cytoplasmic inclusions" is highly specific. I need to confirm if you have a history of pancytopenia or bone pain, and I will request an urgent bone marrow examination to visualize the blasts and inclusions directly.

text: RESULTS: Flow_Cytometry: Abnormal population of blasts expressing CD13, CD33, and CD7 with loss of CD34; Bone_Marrow_Histology: Hypercellular marrow with increased blasts (approx. 30%) and cells containing Auer rods (pink, needle-shaped cytoplasmic inclusions), consistent with Acute Myeloid Leukemia (AML).

speaker: Doctor
text:
DIAGNOSIS READY: Acute Myeloid Leukemia (AML)

The presence of Auer rods and blasts expressing specific myeloid markers (CD13, CD33) with loss of CD34 confirms the diagnosis of Acute Myeloid Leukemia.
